author: smuzaffar
body:
`-DEIGEN_NO_DEBUG` is now defined by default by eigen tool file (https://github.com/cms-sw/cmsdist/pull/10907/changes). This PR proposes to cleanup cmssw code which was explicitly defining it and now causing build warnings in IBs
```
In file included from src/RecoLocalCalo/EcalRecAlgos/src/PulseChiSqSNNLS.cc:1:
  [src/RecoLocalCalo/EcalRecAlgos/interface/PulseChiSqSNNLS.h:4](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-12-2300/RecoLocalCalo/EcalRecAlgos/interface/PulseChiSqSNNLS.h#L4):9: warning: "EIGEN_NO_DEBUG" redefined
     4 | #define EIGEN_NO_DEBUG  // kill throws in eigen code
```
title: Remove duplicate def of EIGEN_NO_DEBUG which is now enable by default
